methods.displayName: Cut carried logs into arrow shafts

start.instruction: Cut one exact regular log into fifteen arrow shafts. Stop when carried logs are exhausted; no tree cutting or shop supply is assumed.

hardRequirements.description: Unboosted level 1 required to cut regular logs into arrow shafts.

freeInventorySlots.description: No additional empty position: the consumed log position can hold the shaft stack.

setupItems.description: One exact ordinary knife in inventory; it is returned, not consumed.

produces.basis: Fifteen arrow shafts per regular log.

stopConditions.description: Re-evaluate at the current RFD unboosted Fletching target.
Recheck when loose regular logs are exhausted.

costs.assumptions: One log is scoped. The knife is returned and shafts share one exact stack; log acquisition is outside scope.

methods.reason: A low-level bounded action that converts one unstackable log into stackable future arrow material.

requirements.description: One exact ordinary knife in inventory.

efficiencyProfiles.notes: Editorial value for one verified carried log and returned knife; no acquisition or hourly rate.

sources.notes: The UIM guide identifies arrow supplies as inventory-light and supports cutting shafts when logs are already available.
Level 1, knife, one regular log and fifteen stackable arrow shafts were reviewed.
Exact knife, regular log and arrow-shaft identities use pinned public gameval constants.

start.instruction: Attach fifteen exact feathers to fifteen exact arrow shafts. Stop when either carried stack cannot fund another set; no shop purchase is assumed.

hardRequirements.description: Unboosted level 1 required to make headless arrows.

freeInventorySlots.description: No unconditional empty position; the flow preserves input stacks that remain and checks whether an output stack needs space.

consumes.description: Fifteen exact arrow shafts from one shared stack.
Fifteen exact feathers from one shared stack.

stopConditions.description: Re-evaluate at the current RFD unboosted Fletching target.
Recheck when fewer than fifteen arrow shafts remain.
Recheck when fewer than fifteen feathers remain.

costs.assumptions: One set is scoped. Existing stacks may remain after consumption; direct positions decide whether the output fits.

methods.reason: A portable UIM side activity with exact stack-aware capacity and no acquisition promise.

efficiencyProfiles.notes: Editorial value for a verified portable set; no future shop supply or hourly rate.

sources.notes: The UIM guide recommends headless arrows as an inventory-light portable training path and does not make supply acquisition automatic.
Level 1 and the exact fifteen-shaft plus fifteen-feather recipe producing fifteen stackable headless arrows were reviewed.
Exact arrow shaft, feather and headless-arrow identities use pinned public gameval constants.
